evals.prompt: I have a Python agent harness with a few tool functions. I want every tool call checked against a policy that only allows file_bug, search_wiki and web_search, with every other tool denied, and every call audited. How do I do that with the agentware SDK, and what happens when a call is denied? Do not execute anything — just explain in text, with code where it helps.
evals.expected_output: Wrap calls in AuditedToolClient with a SimplePolicyEvaluator(Policy(rules=[Rule(... action=Action.ALLOW)], default_deny=True)); a denied call raises PermissionError and is still audited.
expectations: uses AuditedToolClient
sets the policy to default deny
says a denied call raises PermissionError

checks.text: uses AuditedToolClient
sets the policy to default deny
says a denied call raises PermissionError

evals.prompt: My agentware harness uses a local Policy today. How do I switch it so Kei's workspace policy decides each tool call instead, and what happens if the kei-proxy binary is missing or KEI_RUNTIME_TOKEN is not set? Do not execute anything — just explain in text, with code where it helps.
evals.expected_output: Replace the evaluator with KeiProxyEvaluator(KeiProxyAuthorizeClient(...)) via with_policy; it fails closed — a missing binary (proxy_unavailable) or missing token (missing_token) is a DENY.
expectations: uses KeiProxyEvaluator
says a missing binary or token results in a deny
describes the behaviour as fail closed

checks.text: uses KeiProxyEvaluator
says a missing binary or token results in a deny
describes the behaviour as fail closed

evals.prompt: I'm defining a tool that creates a Google Drive document. Which argument carries the parent relationship, and should the tool also take drive_id so the agent can choose the shared drive? Do not execute anything — just explain in text, with code where it helps.
evals.expected_output: A Drive document is created in a folder, so the tool takes folder_id (the child carries the parent's identifier). drive_id is proxy-delegated scope that comes from the runtime token and connector binding; it is never an argument, because an agent that can pass it can widen its own scope.
expectations: uses folder_id as the parent argument
says drive_id is proxy-delegated scope, not a tool argument

checks.text: uses folder_id as the parent argument
